tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa dug sel ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags bzhugs/

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya dzaṃ gu li nā ma bid+ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa dug sel ba zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na/ rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin kyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dge slong rnams la bka' stsal pa/ dge slong dag sngon byung ba byang chub sems dpar gyur pa na/ gangs kyis ri yi byang ngos na// spos dang ldan pa'i ri bo la// ri rgyal de yi sul gnas tshe// gon nu bsod nams brgya yi mtshan// e na ya yi pags gyon la// sbrul gyis brgyan pa'i ska rags can// gdug pa'i sbrul gyis mgobargyan byas// mthong na gdug pa'i rna rgyanacan// dug gi me tog rnams za zhing*// ma lu ta yi lcug khu 'thung*// nga la de 'bod 'bod du 'jug /bu khyod tshur shog nga la nyon// nga la dug sel ces bya ba// dug 'jig rig sngags dam pa yod// dug rnams gang yin de kun ni// nga yi ming gis 'jigs par 'gyur// 'di lta ste/ oṃ e li mit+te/ i li ti li mi te/ dum+be/ dum+ba lī ye/ du se du sa la ye/ tak+ke ta ka karne/ marme marme ra he/ kash+ma re/ kash+ma ra mu ka te/ agha ne/ i li/ i li ye/ a khā ī li/ a ba i ye/ shwe te shwe tā/ tun+te/ a na mu/ rak+te swā hā/ dge slong dag nga'i dug sel gyi rig sngags 'di ni/ sbyin pa thams cad dkar po ste/ sus rig sngags 'di lan cig thos pa de la lo bdun gyi bar du sbrul gyis mi za'o// de'i lus la dug gis mi tshugs so// sbrul gang zhig de la 'dzin pa de'i mgo shing ardza ka'i dog pa bzhin du tshal pa bdun du 'gas so// gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di sbrul gyis mdun du brjod par mi bya'o// de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbrul de 'chi ba'i phyir ro// 'di lta ste/

i la lī/ tsi la lī/ tsakra// bag+go/ ko ta/ ko ṭe ta/ kur ṭa/ kur ṭe ti/ s+pho ṭa/ s+pho ṭe ti/ pu ru ṭe ti/ ma ṭa/ mo ṭe ti/ ni ku ru ṭa/ ni ku ru ṭe te/ mu ru ṭe ti/ ni mu ru ṭe ti/ phu ru ṭa/ phu ṭa ṭa ha re/ phu ṭa ṭa da na/ ta ha re/ nā ga ha re/ nā ga ṭa ta na/ ta ha re/ sarba ha re/ sarba ṭaṭ+ṭan/ ṭa ra he/ āts+tshi/ āts+tsha le/ tsha le/ tsha le/ bi she/ shā te/ shī ta/ bar ta le/ mā ta le/ ha le he le/ ha la ha la ha le/ i la le/ ke pa tsa le/ mi la le/ ta na ṭi ta na ṭi/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ spu ta spu ta/ phaṭa phaṭa ha ra bi ṣa swā hā// dge slong dag de ltar na/ dug sel gyi 'byung po 'dus pa thams cad la rig sngags gang brjod cing bsnyad pa de dag thams cad ni de bzhin no// gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin no// yang dag pa'o// bden pa'o// ma nor ba'o// phyin ci ma log pa'o// dug 'di ma 'dug par gyur cig /sbyin par byed pa'i gan du song zhig /'dzin pa'i gan du song zhig /me'i nang du song zhig /chu'i nang du song zhig /thang la song zhig /ka ba'i nang du song zhig /rtsig pa'i gan du song zhig /nam mkha' la song zhig /sa'i nang du song zhig /zhi bar gyur cig swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ dge slong de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa dug sel zhes bya ba'i rig sngags rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ sid+dhi pa thi ti bha ga wān ār+ya aṃ gu li nā ma bid+ya rā dz+nye/ bod skad du/ bklags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sor mo can zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal mo// sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar dge slong rnams ri dri rgyal na gnas te/ de'i tshe 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug kyang de na bzhugs te/ des bdag la smras pa/ bu sngags kyi tshig 'di nyon cig /klu'i dbang po rnams kyi dug med par byed/

sbrul gyi dug med par byed/ gdon rnams dang*/ srin po rnams dang*/ 'byung po rnams dang*/ sha za rnams dang*/ sems can stobs po che rnams dang*/ grul bum rnams dang*/ sems can phra men rnams dang*/ phra men pha dang*/ phra men ma dang*/ chu srin dang*/ stag dang*/ grul bum rwa can dang*/ mche ba can gyis de ltar sngags kyi tshig drag shul chen po aṃ gu li yang dag par thos na sngags kyi gtso bo sems can gdug pa rab tu 'jil bar byed pa ste/ sngags can gang gis de shes na lha rnams kyi gdug pa yang dag par med par byed do// oṃ na mo bha ga ba te ār+ya aṃ gu li/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ klu'am/ klu mo'am/ sbrul pho'am/ sbrul mo'am/ gnod sbyin pho'am/ gnod sbyin mo'am/ 'byung po'am/ 'byung mo'am/ phra men pha'am/ phra men ma'am/ gdug pas ma zin pa yang rung ste/ pha pha pha/ ha re ha re ha re/ re dza re be sha be/ mā ga re/ sarba ra re/ ha ra ha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ ma ra ma ra/ ma ra ya mā ra ya/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ mo ṭa ya/ mo ṭa ya/ mo ṭa ya/ shī gh+raṃ shī gh+raṃ/ la ghu la ghu/ ā na ya ā na ya/ dha ra dha ra/ ban dha ban dha ban dha/ ghur+ṇa ghur+ṇa/ ghur+ṇa pa ya ghur+ṇa pa ya/ dpag tshad stong brgyad cu na gnas pa'i klu rnams kyi gdug pa med par mdzod cig /klu thams cad chings shig /gsod cig /thar bar mdzod cig /oṃ hu lu hu lu/ ha la ha la/ ha la bi shaṃ/ bcom ldan 'das ma grub pa'i rgyal mo aṃ gu lir bka' stsal pa/ ta ka ke ṭa ka ke /ta ka ke ni ṭa ka ka ni/ shi ra shi ra/ tsaṇ+ḍa ke sha ro hi ni/ gegs thams cad sel bar mdzad pa can/ las stong can/ bcom ldan 'das ma grub pa aṃ gu la ta thā bi ga ta/ klu mo'i tshogs sum cus mchod pa/ dza ya dza ya sid+dhi/ rgyal bar mdzad pa/ mi yi mgo bo'i thod kyi 'phreng ba can/ hūm̐ k+ṣa skad cig thang cig yud tsam nyin bar gyi bar du dug sel ba/ a su su ra de ba ti dang*/ ngan pa'i stobs 'joms par byed pa can/

gegs 'joms par byed pa can/ lha'i yum khyod la phyag 'tshal bstod swā hā/ sngags kyi tshig drag shul can sbrul gyi mdun du bklag par mi bya ste/ 'ching ba dang*/ klad pa 'gas shing tshal pa brgyar 'gyur ro// sngags kyi drag shul can chen mo sbrul gyis thos nas thams cad 'tshig par byed do// oṃ ki li ki li/ ma hā ki li/ kā la rū bi ni/ gegs thams cad zlog cig /pha pham pha rol pham par mdzod cig swā hā/ bklags pas grub pa a guṃ la'i snying po dang bcas pa'o// tad+ya thā/ oṃ dhu ne dha ne/ dhu ni dhu ni/ sat+ya/ sat+ya/ ṭa ha sa ni dhu dhu ni/ ban dha ban dha/ rdo rje'i gzungs mang pos bka' stsal pa/ 'jog po'i dug 'dor du 'jug la/ dza ya dza ya/ muṃ dza mu dza/ muṃ dza muṃ dza/ thong zhig /glog dang rlung zhes bya ba mgyogs pa'i shugs can ro langs chen po bcom ldan 'das ma shākya thub pa'i zhal nas 'byung*/ mu ya muṃ tsa mu tsa swā hā/ bklags pas grub pa bcom ldan 'das ma 'phags ma sor mo can zhes bya ba rig pa'i rgyal mo rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya sarba dharma ma tṛ ka nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod kyis chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i phyag rgya'i gzungs/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs te/ nga yang da ltar 'chad pa zungs shig /tad+ya thā/ a brte/ a brte/ bi brte/ bi brte/ bha ga ma/ shud+dhe/ pra bha sā re/ ta ra ṇe/ ug kha le/ mug kha le/ sarba dharmaḥ pā sha pa n+yai swā hā/ de nas gnas gtsang ma'i lha rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang 'di'i snying po brjod par bya'o// tad+ya thā/

ats+tshe/ a na le/ e lu le/ a lu phe/ murta a nu ga te/ sarba dharma a dhi ba ti ya pra te/ dz+yo sna ka ra/ a dhi ga ta dz+nyā ne/ bi shud+dhe pa ti swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// chos thams cad kyi yum zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ rgyagar skad du/ ār+ya tsu ḍā ma ṇi nā ma dha ra ṇi/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba mtha' yas pa ma lus par khyab pa mchog tu rmad du byung zhing rnam par dag pa'i thugs mnga' ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa/ mi 'jigs pa'i sbyin pa/ phongs pa thams cad las yongs su skyob par mdzad pa/ 'jigs pa thams cad las rnam par thar bar mdzad pa/ yams kyi nad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad 'jigs par mdzad pa/ mi mthun pa dang*/ rtsod pa dang*/ 'thab pa dang*/ 'gyed pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar mdzad pa/ sdig pa thams cad 'joms par mdzad pa dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ ro langs dang*/ gshis ngan du 'chi pa dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa dang*/ gegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'jigs par mdzad pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs dang*/ mu ge dang*/ mya ngan gyi 'jigs pa thams cad zlog par mdzad pa/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po thams cad 'dun par mdzad pa/ dug dang*/ 'brum phran dang*/ thor bu dang*/ gshed byed dang*/

byad dang*/ ro langs dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad 'jigs par mdzad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gshed byed thams cad sel mdzad pa// sdig pa thams cad 'phrog pa nyid// nor dang 'bru rnams 'phel mdzad pa// bdag gi bu dang tsha bo dang*// g.yog 'khor rtag tu ma 'gyur ba// phyir bzlog pa ni brjod par bya// lha dang lha min g.yul 'gyed tshe// brgya byin lha min rnams las pham// de nas rengs pa kho nar ni// 'jig rten dbang gi drung song ste// de nas snying ni rab skrag nas// 'di skad kyis ni tshig gsol to// lha min bdag pham 'jig rten dbang*// ji ltar bdag gis nan tan bgyi// 'jig rten dbang po dag la ni// lha yis gzigs pas rtag tu gzigs// brgya byin gyi ni tshig gsan nas// dbang phyug gis ni 'di skad gsungs// lha yi dbang po nga la nyon// khyod la ngas ni bsrung ba byin// lha'i dbang po sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'jig rten gyis rnam par bltas pa zhes bya ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten dbang phyug 'od las/ ngas gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i phyir bzlog pa de bzhin gshegs pa bye bas gsungs pa'i gzungs so// mkhas pa gang gis rig sngags 'di/ bris nas spyi bor 'dogs pa'am// 'don tam 'on te klog na yang*// de yi 'jigs pa kun med do// rtag tu bsrung zhing sba ba dang*// g.yul 'gyed pa ni rgyal bar byed// sdig dang rmi lam zhi ba dang*// bsod nams bkra shis rab tu 'phel/ lha yi dbang po de bas na// gang zhig rgyal bar 'gyur 'dod pas/ bris te spyi bor gdags par bya// yid la rtag tu dran par gyis// g.yul 'gyed 'ba' zhig ma yin te// 'di ni rtag tu sdig pa 'phrog /bud med rnams la bu pho bskyed// mngal na gnas pa yongs su skyong*// phun sum tshogs pa thams cad byed// sdig pa thams cad rab tu 'jig

/'di ming phyir zlog byed ces bya// yan lag rnams la phyir 'bab byed// lha'i dbang po phyir bzlog pa zhes bya ba/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo chen mos sems can thams cad la phan par byed pa/ lha ma yin thams cad pham par byed pa/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa zung zhig sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bdun nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dag dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ oṃ dza ya ka ri/ yud+dho ta tā ra ṇi bi tsa tra mu khi/ sarba mang ga la dha ra ṇi/ dzi mu te sa ha sra bhu dze/ sa ha sra ne tre/ sa ha sra sha re/ nra na laṃ ka ra/ bi bhu ṣi te/ maṇi kuṇ+ḍa la san nā ha sa na nā de bi tsi tra mau/ li dha re/ tsan+d+ra sūr+ya/ a ta re ke /ā kā sha ga na/ tsā ri ṇi/ maṃ ga la shi re dzī mau de/ ba ba tri kri ta maṃ ga le/ bhu ri mi dhī ka ra ṇe/ tsu ru tsu ru/ shwe ta pa ste/ mu ru mu ru/ shwa ta/ a ba na te/ hu ru hu ru/ pa bid di tra mu khi/ mu ku ru ku ru/ tsan+d+ra mu khe/ ā di t+ya ba sha brti ni/ dzam+bha ni/ maṃ ga la dha ra ṇi/ stam+bha ni/ sarba bid+ya dha ra mā te/ mo ha ni/ a mo gha dā sha ha ste/ sarba bha ya bi mo tsa ni/ rā dza tso ri/ ag+mi biṣa/ ud ka bha ya pra sha ma ni/ ka khorda ni bā ra ṇi/ oṃ hi ri hi ri/ dz+wa ya ka ri/ pa la ka ri/ dha na ka ri/ te dza ska ri bi bā da/ pra sha ma ni/ yud dha ni/ bā ra ni/ pa ra tsa kra pra sha ma ni/ pa ra sain+ya bi n+ya sha ni/ yud+dho t+ta ra bi/ pra bha da pe la/ ma ṇi ma ṇi/ ma hā ma ṇi/ ma ṇi na dha ri/ tri lo ka ā lo ka ka ri/ tri pu ra na ga ra bi dha na sa ni/ pa ra sai n+ya bi dra ba ni/ sarba kra t+yi karma ni su da ni/ sarba bya dhi ni ma pra sha ma ni/ oṃ tsi le mi li swā hā/ tsi le me le swā hā/ mi li mi li swā hā/ tsi li tsi li swā hā/

tsi khi li/ tsi khi li swā hā/ tsaṇ+ḍa li mi ṭi ni swā hā/ ur+dhe ke shi paṃ gi le/ piṃ ga lak+ṣi dha mu khi swā hā/ oṃ ka ra ka ra/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ si ri si ri/ su ru su ru/ muñca muñca/ muñca/ pa ya/ pra sha ma ya/ pra sha na ya/ yud dhod ta ra ṇi phaṭa/ tsit+ta ni re ma la ka ri phaṭa/ a su ra ni ra gha ta ni/ phaṭa dza ya ka ri phaṭa/ pri ti ka ri phaṭa/ sa ha sra shi re phaṭa/ sa ha sra bhu dze phaṭa/ san sra ne tre phaṭa/ sarba bid+ya dha ra dha ra na meskri ta phaṭa/ sarba sha truṃ nā sha ni phaṭa/ sarba bha ya bi mo k+ṣa ni phaṭa/ pa ra tsa kra ni ba ra ni phaṭa/ pa ra sai n+ya bi dra ba ni phaṭa/ sarba kri t+ya/ karma sā da ni phaṭa/ sarba bya dhi pra shā mi ni phaṭa/ sarba gra hod sā da ni phaṭa/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa nān/ saṃ tā mi tri nān/ so ba ta sta ya ka nān/ sa pa ri bā ra nān/ te dza sa ma ma shi ra ra na/ sarba bha yo ba dre bh+yaḥ sarba yu dhe bh+yaḥ sarba byā dhi bh+yaḥ sarba tu skri te bh+yaḥ sarba kri t+ya ka khorde bh+yaḥ sarba bi ṣe bh+yaḥ sarba kā ya tsit+ta bī dī bā bh+ya sh+tsā/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ swā hā/ gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i phyir zlog pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar byed pa/ nad thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa/ thams cad du zhi bar byed pa/ bsod nams thams cad gsog par byed pa/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yang dag par ba sten par byed pa/ rnam pa thams cad du dpal du byed pa ste/ yi ger bris pa dang*/ ston pa dang*/ bklags pa dang*/ bzung bas bdag dang*/ gzhan bsrung ba'o// de bzhin du khrus byas pa dang*/ sbyin sregs gyis yams kyi nad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'o// 'phags pa gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shi lan+d+re bo dhi dang*/ zhu chen gyi lo ts+tsha ba ban+de ye shes sdes bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o/// / ༈ rgya gar skad du/

ār+ya ṣa ṭa k+ṣa ra bid+ya/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa yi ge drug pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan yod na bzhugs te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags gang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas drug dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bshad pa/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di kun dga' bo khyod kyis zungs shig /chongs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /tad+ya thā/ dan+ti le/ kan+ti le/ dan+ti mi ti/ ma dhu ma ma ti/ ma dhu ma ti/ ka rīn+ta te/ ko ran+ḍa dra bi ti/ ko shā bī/ tsha ṭa dza/ du du ma te/ ke tu ma ti/ tsu du na dhe/ ku ṭa dan+te/ ta ru hu re/ en ni ge /hu tra ba hu ni/ kun dga' bo 'di ni yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags so// klad pa na ba dang*/ mig na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ sna na ba dang*/ lce na ba dang*/ snying na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ rtsib logs na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ byin pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba dang*/ zas ma bzhu ba dang*/ sbos pa dang*/ mngal du thogs pa dang*/ rlung las gyur pa dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa dang*/ rims drag po dang*/ nyin gcig pa dang*/ nyin gnyis pa dang*/ nyin gsum pa dang*/ nyin bzhi pa dang*/ rims yud tsam pa dang*/ nyin mo'i rims dang*/ mtshan mo'i rims kyis btab la/ yi ge drug pa'i rig sngags 'dis bsrung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyab pa dang*/ yongs su bsrung ba dang*/ yongs su bskyang ba dang*/ zhi ba dang*/ bde legs su gyur pa dang*/ chad pa spang ba dang*/ mtshon cha spang ba dang*/ dug gzhil ba dang*/ chus gtor ba dang*/

srad bus bcings pa byas pa las gang zhig 'gal bar byed na/ de'i mgo a rdza ka'i bdog pa bzhin du tshal pa bdun du mi 'gas pa ni/ kun dga' bo ngas lha dang bcas pa dang*/ bdud dang bcas pa dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ dge sbyong dang*/ bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang*/ lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten na ma mthong ngo*// tad+ya thā/ aṇ+ḍa re/ paṇ+ḍa re/ ka ra ṭa/ ke yu re/ bhu ta gra he/ bhu ta gra he/ bhu ta pra kyi te/ bhu ta ya smra ya ni/ pra ya ba ti/ te dza ba ti/ ya sho ba ti/ gi ri ṇi ni/ bdag 'jigs pa thams cad dang*/ gnod pa thams cad las bde legs su gyur cig swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang*/ lha dang mi dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do/// /'phags pa yi ge drug pa zhes bya ba'i rig sngags rdzogs so/// /

༄༅// byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zhi bar byed pa dang gzungs le tshan brgyad bzhugs so// ༄༅// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// stong chen mo rab tu 'joms ma la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas tshangs pa tshangs chen gyis// langs te thal mo sbyar btud nas// stong chen rab tu 'joms byed pa// legs par gsungs pa'i rig sngags 'di// byis pa rnams la phan bgyid pa// rig sngags bdag gis brjod par bgyi// gang gis dang por 'dzam gling du// rig sngags rab tu ston mdzad pa// chos kyi rgyal po snang mdzad pa// sangs rgyas dpal la phyag 'tshal lo// khyad par 'phags pa'i chos rnams dang*// tshogs kyi dam pa dge 'dun dang*// sangs rgyas zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ tshangs pas 'di skad tshig gsol to// gang dag sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas// sangs rgyas kyi ni nyan thos dang*// drang srong dang ni 'jig rten skong*// lha rnams ji snyed mchis pa dag /de kun mi yi 'jig rten na// 'di las skyes ba sha stag go /thub chen mngal la 'tshal ba yi// gnod sbyin srin po 'di na mchis// rgyal po rnams kyis mthong mi nus// bstan par yang ni mi nus so// gang la bu ni mi chags dang*// gang gi mngal du mi gnas dang*// skyes pa bud med 'du ba na// dbang po rnams ni myos par bgyid// mer mer po dang nur nur po// bu yi sa bon ma rung ster// gang yang mngal ni thur du 'gyur// sha ma mi 'byung gnod bgyid pa/ de rnams mi 'byung gnod bgyid pa// 'jig rten mgon po bdag la gson// 'jam pa po dang ri dwags rgyal// skem byed rjed byed khu tshur can// ma mo dang ni dza mi ka /'dod pa can dang nam gru dang*// srul po dang ni ma dga' byed/ bya dang gnya' ba'i lag can dang*// bzhin brgyan dang ni mig 'phyang ba// de dag thams cad sa la rgyu// gdon rnams bco lnga de dag ni// byis pa rnams la 'jigs par bgyid// ji ltar byis pa 'dzin pa yi// mtshan dang gzungs kyang brjod par bgyi// 'jam pa pos ni zin gyur na// mig ni rab tu 'gyur bar bgyid// ri dwags rgyal gyis zin gyur na// skyugs pa mi bzad bskyag par 'gyur// skem byed kyis ni zin gyur na// mig ni rab tu 'gyu bar bgyid// skem byed pas ni byis pa 'gul// brjed byed kyis ni zan gyur na// 'gro zhing de ltar sgra yang 'byin// dbu ba dang ni kha chu 'dzag

/khu tshur can kyis rab zin na// khu tshur 'chang zhing 'byed par bgyid/ ma mo yis ni zin gyur na// rgod cing de bzhin sgra yang 'byin// dza mi kas ni rab zin na// nu zho nu bar mngon mi dga'// 'dod pa can gyis rab zin na// mal na gnyid log ngu bar 'gyur// nam grus rab tu zin gyur na// lce la sos ni 'cha' bar bgyis// srul pos rab tu zin gyur na// ku co 'don cing sgra yang 'byin// ma dga' byed pas zin gyur na// rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs su 'gyur/ bya yis rab tu zin gyur na// mnam pa'i 'dri ni 'byung bar 'gyur// gnya' lag can gyis zin gyur na// mgul ba rab tu 'gag par 'gyur// bzhin rgyan gyis ni zin gyur na// rims kyis btab cing 'khru bar 'gyur// mig 'phyang bas ni zin gyur na// skyigs bu dang ni rngam pa 'byung*// byis pa ji ltar skrag bgyid pa// de yi gzugs ni brjod par bgyi// 'jam pa po ni ba lang gzugs// ri dwags rgyal po ri dwags 'dra// skem byed pa ni gzhon nu'i gzugs// brjed byed pa ni wa 'dra'o// khu tshur can ni bya rog gzugs// ma mo de ni ra yi gzugs// dza mi ka ni rta yi gzugs// 'dod pa can ni rdo rje'i gzugs// nam gru khyi yi gzugs kyis te// srul po phag gi gzugs kyis so// ma dga' byed pa byi la'i gzugs// bya ni 'dab chags gzugs kyis so// gnya' lag can ni bya gag gzugs// bzhin rgyan 'ug pa'i gzugs su su ste/ mig 'phyang ba ni pha wang gzugs// 'di dag byis pa skrag par bgyid// 'di dag bu 'phrog ma rungs pa// byis pa rnams la 'jigs bgyid pa// mdo sde'i zhags pas drangs nas ni// 'di dag shin tu dgug par bgyi// gnod sbyin sde dpon chen po ni// dri za tsan+dan zhes bgyi bar// yi ge phyag rgya de bstsal te// srod la gdon ni drag po ba// bco lnga de dag khug cig ces// pho nya yang ni btang bar bgyi// de dag rnams ni skad cig gis// bcing ba lnga yis bcing bzhin dgug

/de nas 'jig rten mgon po la/ tshangs chen thal sbyar 'di skad gsol// srog chags sa bon 'jig bgyid pa// 'byung po 'di dag rnams lhags te// mgon po yi ni spyan snga ru// 'di dag chad pa bshad par bgyi// bud med gang dag bu mi 'tshal// gang zhig btsas pa 'dzin 'tshal bas// tshes brgyad dang ni bcu bzhi la// bslab bzung dam chos skyabs mchi la// mchod rten legs par mchod par bgyi// khrus bgyis shin tu brgyan nas ni// sa gzhir yungs kar gtor nas su// me tog spos kyis brgyan par bgyi// sna lnga'i tshon gyi skud pas ni// khor yug tu ni bskor bar bgyi// nam phyed bar du mchis nas ni// spyi bor yungs kar bzhag nas su// tshangs pas rab tu byas pa ste/ tshangs pas sprul bcas brjod par bgyi// lo grangs bcu gnyis bar du ni// gzhon nu rnams la phan bgyid pa// tshangs pas sprul pa'i mdo sde yi// rig sngags 'di las gang 'da' ba// ardza ka yi dog pa bzhin// mgo bo tshal pa bdun du 'gas// s+yād+ya the dan/ aṃ ge /baṃ ge /bhāṃ ge /bha ba ne/ i nan di/ bi nan di/ su lu ri/ gi ri gi ri/ sha wa ri/ ga ru ni/ sha ru ni/ gi ri/ a ba re lo tsa ne/ la sa ne/ re tsa ne/ a le bhe/ aṃ ga ne/ a la bhe/ ta la bhe/ pra kar ṣi ni swā hā// mngal na bde bar gnas gyur cig /dbang po yang dag 'phel bar shog /mngal na 'dug pa bde gyur cig /btsas pa 'jig par ma gyur cig /mngal na bde bar gnas gyur cig /dus bzhin du ni 'byung bar shog /tshon skud sna tshogs rnams dang ni// yungs kar 'bru ni ma grugs pa// de dag srung bar gsungs pa ste// byis pa ring du 'tsho bar shog /de nas ston pa kun mkhyen gyis// rig pa'i sngags ni 'di dag gsungs// mngal na 'dug pa bsrung bar shog /byis pa rnams ni bde gyur cig /s+yād+ya the dan/ bo dhi bo dhi/ ma hā bo dhi/ bo dha a nu ma te/ pha le ni/ ba hu pha le/

shi k+ṣa shi k+ṣa/ sā ra ba te/ sā ga le/ du rā sa de/ du rā ga me/ shū ra pra ba te/ shū ra ba te/ bha ge /bha gā bha ge /bha gi ni ni bā ri ṇi swā hā/ de nas gdon ni bco lnga po// rtag tu khrag la 'thung rnams kyis// 'jig rten mgon la phyag 'tshal te// thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad gsol// grong ngam khyim mam grong khyer ram// gang na legs par gsungs pa yi// mdo sde 'di ni bzhugs pa der// byis pa rnams ni 'chi mi 'gyur// thub chen khyod ni ji bzhin du// rjes su mthun par 'jug par bgyi// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags kyi tshig rnams grub par gyur cig /grub par gyur cig /rig sngags kyis sgrol bar gyur cig /tshangs pas bsams par gyur cig swā hā/ byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga zhi bar byed pa'i gzungs rdzogs so/// / ༈ 'phags pa blo gros rgya mtshos zhus pa'i mdo las byung ba'i bdud gzhoms pa'i sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ sha me/ sha ma wa ti/ sha mi ta sha truṃ/ aṃ ku re/ maṃ ku re/ mā ra dzi te/ ka rā ṭe/ ke yū re/ te dzo wa ti/ o dzo ya ni/ bi shiṣ+ṭa nirma le/ ma lā sa ne/ o kha re/ kha ge gra se/ gra sa ne/ o mu khā+e/ pa rāṃ mu khī/ pa raṃ mu khī/ sha mi tā ni/ sarba gra ha ban+dha na ni/ nirga hi ta/ sarba pa ra pra ba ti di na/ bi muk+ta ma rā pā shā/ s+tha bi ta/ bud+dha mu drā/ a nuṅga ti tā/ sarba mā rai/ a tsa li ta/ pā da pa ri shud+dha/ bi gats+tshan+tu/ sarba mā ra karma ṇi/ zhes pa 'di chos kyi gtam sogs byed pa'i sngon du brjod na bdud kyi bar chad mi 'jug cing glags mi rnyed par gsungs so/// / ༈ 'don pa 'bum 'gyur du 'gro ba'i sngags bsngo ba 'khor lo'i mdo nas gsungs pa ni/ oṃ gha dha ra bi dha ra swā hā/ rat+na sha kho na ta thā ga tā ya a pra ti ha ta shā sa na nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hī khā hī/ hūṃ hūṃ/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/

tiṣ+ṭhā tiṣ+ṭhā/ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'o// ༈ smon lam btab tshad 'grub pa'i sngags ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ oṃ pañci dri ya a wa bo dha ni swā hā/ 'di smon lam gyi rjes la bton na rang gis smon lam btab tshad 'grub par/ smon lam yongs su grub pa'i mdo nas gsungs so/// / ༈ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa/ na mas+t+rai sa ya dhī kā nāṃ ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba trā pra ti ha p+ti bā dharma tā ba li ni/ a sa ma sa man+ta to/ nan+tā bā p+ti shā sa ni/ ha ra ha ra sma ra sma ra ṇa/ bi ga ta rā ga bud+dha dharma te/ sa ra sa ra sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ tra ya tra ya/ bha ga wan ma ha ba ra lak+ṣa ṇe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sā ga re swā hā/// / ༈ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga tā badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+rī bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ ༈ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pa la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ dri ḍho me bha ba/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ a nu rak+to me bha ba/ su po ṣ+yo me bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥ ku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan/ badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñca/ he ru ka bha ba/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ hūṃ phaṭa// ༈ hi ta su kha sh+tsa ka ra bud+dha de sha bi stā ra bha ba/ dā na pa ti sa pa ri wa ra s+ya ā yuḥ pu n+ya dha na sh+tsa bar+dha naṃ ku rba wan+tu/ wa h+ya ma bh+ya yoḥ/ sarba a pak+ṣa u pa shin+taṃ ku ra wan+tu/

saṃ gha sa pa ri wā ra s+ya da sha dharma tsar+ya/ sarba sā dha ni war+dha nī bistā ra bha ba/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tshan+tu// ༈ sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgya rtsa bzhi mgrin gcig tu gsungs pa ye shes ta la'i gzungs 'di lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bton na dmyal ba na gnas pa'i sems can yang thar pa thob par som nyi mi dgos pa'i sngags/ s+yād+ya the dan tsak+ṣu/ shu ra da da/ tsak+ṣuḥ bha bha/ dhu la me thā/ ka la ta thā/ i ta ti ta this/ su raṭ+ṭa/ su raṭ+ṭa/ su ta tha ya/ ita thaṃ sa be lā be lā pā ṇi/ tsa ru mūrti ni/ ā ra ni ā ra ni/ kā la pā ni/ kā la pā ni/ tu ru du si/ tu ru du si/ dha su ti dha su ti/ dhi ri dhi ri/ dhu ru dhu ru/ dhu ru dhu ru/ kā la kā la/ sa te thā sa/ gī la gī la/ gī la pa ya/ gi la pa ya/ dhu su dhu su/ suṃ dhu suṃ dhu/ sid thā su/ et+thā su/ e thā sa/ e thā sa pā ni/ yu tsu re dha su/ dha re/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ku ru ku ru/ kurma kurma/ kurma pā ni/ kurma pā ni/ ke lu ke lu/ ke la pā ni/ ke la pā ni/ kaṅkāri kaṅkā ri/ la ru bud+dhe/ dhu ru dhe/ dhu ru dhe/ ma hā dhu ru dhe/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ pi hu si pi hu si/ dha su dha su/ ha su pa ni swā hā// ༈ sdig pa thams cad zhi ba'i sngags/ oṃ ku mā ra rū pa dha ri ni bi shwa sam+bha wa/ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ la ghu la ghu bh+ruṃ bh+ruṃ hūṃ hūṃ h+yaṃ dzi na dzika/ mañju shrī ye tā ra ya maṃ sarba du khe bh+yaḥphaṭa phaṭa/ sa ma ya/ sa ma ya/ a mri tota bha wa pā paṃ me nā sha ya swā hā/// / ༈ tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i yon gyi bdag po dang*// zhus brkos bris byed rang dang pha mas gtsos// 'gro kun tshe 'dir bde skyid phun tshogs shing*// phyi ma byang chub snying po myur thobashog /sarba maṅga laṃ/// /
